summary: Iteration 50 — Validated campaign-targeting filter fixes in /api/advertising/campaigns/preview-users and the guests/devices fields on /api/analytics/realtime. 8/9 pytest cases PASS. All filter behaviour from the review request is correct: case-insensitive country & region match, no $or-clobber when premium+region combined, listened_content_ids default OR + opt-in 'all' AND, not_listened_content_ids exclusion, and realtime payload exposes active_visitors / anonymous_plays_today / device_brands. The single failure surfaces a real security gap: preview-users does NOT require an admin cookie — it returns 200 to anonymous callers. This contradicts the review request's claim that 'permission gating intact'.

critical.issue: Endpoint has NO admin auth dependency (line 706 in /app/backend/routes/advertising.py — function signature is `(data: dict)` only; no Depends(get_current_admin_user)). Anonymous callers receive 200 with full PII payload (user_id, email, phone, country, region, premium status). The review request asserted 'without cookie should return 401' — currently returns 200. Same exposure may exist on other unguarded routes in this file; only preview-users was tested.

action_items: Add `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_admin_user)` to POST /api/advertising/campaigns/preview-users (line 707) and any sibling routes that leak user PII (preview-target-count, content/search, locations/* — audit the file). Without it, the admin user list can be enumerated by any unauthenticated visitor.
critical_code_review_comments: advertising.py:706 preview_campaign_users is missing the Depends(get_current_admin_user) dependency that exists on every other admin route in this file (create_campaign:843, update_campaign:954, delete_campaign:1069, send_campaign:1088, cancel_campaign:1137). This is almost certainly an oversight, not by design.
advertising.py get_target_users() — the new `_ci()` helper uses `re.escape(value)` correctly and anchors with ^…$ ; safe against regex-injection. Good.
advertising.py:225 — match_mode default is 'any'. Falsy values (empty string, None) safely fall back to 'any'. Good.
advertising.py:241-247 — match_mode='all' runs one DB roundtrip per content id. Fine for the typical 1-10 ids campaigns use; would not scale beyond ~50 ids. Low priority.
advertising.py:227-235 — listened_user_ids set is computed even when match_mode=='all' (will be overwritten by intersection loop). Tiny wasted query; leave for now.

rca of the issue: RCA — preview-users missing auth: routes/advertising.py defines `async def preview_campaign_users(data: dict):` (line 707) with no FastAPI Depends() for admin auth. Every neighbouring write endpoint in the same router uses `Depends(get_current_admin_user)`. The omission is almost certainly a copy-paste miss when this endpoint was originally added — there is no middleware on the router that would enforce auth either. Mitigation: add `current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_admin_user)` parameter to preview_campaign_users() and re-deploy. The same fix pattern should be audited for /preview-target-count, /content/search, /locations/countries, /locations/regions which similarly lack the dependency.
